About Me

Turning ideas into playable experiences

I am a passionate and creative Unity Game Developer with experience developing 2D and 3D games using Unity and C#. I enjoy transforming game ideas into playable experiences by building gameplay mechanics, player controllers, physics systems, collision systems, UI and interactive environments.

I have experience working with gameplay systems, player movement, camera systems, physics, collision detection, UI development, scene management, level design and debugging.

I am continuously improving my skills in game development and enjoy solving technical problems, designing gameplay mechanics and creating enjoyable player experiences.
